parameters.content:
## WF-09 — QL-CHATWOOT-TAG-MANAGER

**Objetivo:** Autoridad unica de labels CRIS en Chatwoot.

**Fuente de verdad:** ConversationState en Supabase. Chatwoot es solo proyeccion visual reconstruible.

**CRON:** cada 5 minutos (reconciliador)
**Webhook:** POST /cris-tags-sync para sincronizacion inmediata por conversacion

**Flujo:**
1. Lee conversaciones con chatwoot_conv_id
2. Trae metadata backend: estado, marca, source, ventana, plan
3. GET labels actuales desde Chatwoot
4. Calcula labels deseadas desde ConversationState
5. Valida exclusividad por categoria y limpia aliases legacy
6. Preserva tags externos
7. Si cambiaron -> POST labels completas + evento TAG_CHANGE

**Regla:** ningun otro workflow debe hacer POST directo de labels CRIS.
**Version:** 2026-06-22

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;

SELECT
  c.id                           AS conv_id,
  c.estado::text                 AS estado,
  c.marca::text                  AS marca,
  c.modelo::text                 AS modelo,
  c.quicklink_id::text           AS quicklink_id,
  c.chatwoot_conv_id::integer    AS chatwoot_conv_id,
  c.chatwoot_contact_id::integer AS chatwoot_contact_id,
  c.intentos_realizados,
  COALESCE(lm.source, 'outbound') AS source,
  lm.last_inbound_message_at,
  lm.selected_plan,
  lm.selected_plan_name,
  lm.selected_plan_duration,
  COALESCE(cc.active_model, c.modelo)::text AS active_model,
  COALESCE(cc.active_brand, c.marca::text)::text AS active_brand,
  cc.active_vehicle_id,
  cc.multi_vehicle_mode,
  cc.vehicle_count,
  evaluate_conversation_window(lm.last_inbound_message_at) AS window_eval
FROM conversaciones c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT lm.*
  FROM lead_memory lm
  WHERE lm.conversation_id = c.id
     OR lm.chatwoot_conv_id = c.chatwoot_conv_id
  ORDER BY lm.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) lm ON true
LEFT JOIN conversation_context cc
  ON cc.chatwoot_conv_id = c.chatwoot_conv_id
WHERE c.chatwoot_conv_id IS NOT NULL
  AND c.chatwoot_contact_id IS NOT NULL
  AND c.estado::text <> 'NEW_LEAD'
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 20

parameters.query:
=SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
INSERT INTO eventos_conversacion (conversation_id, tipo_evento, actor, payload)
SELECT NULLIF('{{ $('Code - Compute Tags').item.json.conv_id }}','')::uuid,
       COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('Code - Compute Tags').item.json.event_type }}',''), 'tag_change'),
       'WF-09',
       COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('Code - Compute Tags').item.json.evento_payload }}','')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
WHERE NULLIF('{{ $('Code - Compute Tags').item.json.conv_id }}','') IS NOT NULL

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH req AS (
  SELECT NULLIF($1, '')::uuid AS conv_id,
         NULLIF($2, '')::integer AS chatwoot_conv_id
), matched AS (
  SELECT
    c.id                           AS conv_id,
    c.estado::text                 AS estado,
    c.marca::text                  AS marca,
    c.modelo::text                 AS modelo,
    c.quicklink_id::text           AS quicklink_id,
    c.chatwoot_conv_id::integer    AS chatwoot_conv_id,
    c.chatwoot_contact_id::integer AS chatwoot_contact_id,
    c.intentos_realizados::integer AS intentos_realizados,
    COALESCE(lm.source, 'outbound')::text AS source,
    lm.last_inbound_message_at,
    lm.selected_plan::text,
    lm.selected_plan_name::text,
    lm.selected_plan_duration::text,
    COALESCE(cc.active_model, c.modelo)::text AS active_model,
    COALESCE(cc.active_brand, c.marca::text)::text AS active_brand,
    cc.active_vehicle_id::text,
    cc.multi_vehicle_mode::boolean,
    cc.vehicle_count::integer,
    evaluate_conversation_window(lm.last_inbound_message_at)::jsonb AS window_eval,
    'webhook'::text AS sync_source,
    'target_found'::text AS sync_status
  FROM req
  JOIN conversaciones c
    ON (req.conv_id IS NOT NULL AND c.id = req.conv_id)
    OR (req.chatwoot_conv_id IS NOT NULL AND c.chatwoot_conv_id = req.chatwoot_conv_id)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT lm.*
    FROM lead_memory lm
    WHERE lm.conversation_id = c.id
       OR lm.chatwoot_conv_id = c.chatwoot_conv_id
    ORDER BY lm.updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) lm ON true
  LEFT JOIN conversation_context cc
    ON cc.chatwoot_conv_id = c.chatwoot_conv_id
  WHERE c.chatwoot_conv_id IS NOT NULL
    AND c.chatwoot_contact_id IS NOT NULL
    AND c.estado::text <> 'NEW_LEAD'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM matched
UNION ALL
SELECT
  req.conv_id                      AS conv_id,
  NULL::text                       AS estado,
  NULL::text                       AS marca,
  NULL::text                       AS modelo,
  NULL::text                       AS quicklink_id,
  req.chatwoot_conv_id::integer    AS chatwoot_conv_id,
  NULL::integer                    AS chatwoot_contact_id,
  NULL::integer                    AS intentos_realizados,
  'outbound'::text                 AS source,
  NULL::timestamp with time zone   AS last_inbound_message_at,
  NULL::text                       AS selected_plan,
  NULL::text                       AS selected_plan_name,
  NULL::text                       AS selected_plan_duration,
  NULL::text                       AS active_model,
  NULL::text                       AS active_brand,
  NULL::text                       AS active_vehicle_id,
  NULL::boolean                    AS multi_vehicle_mode,
  NULL::integer                    AS vehicle_count,
  NULL::jsonb                      AS window_eval,
  'webhook'::text                  AS sync_source,
  'target_not_found'::text         AS sync_status
FROM req
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matched)
